figurative_meaning_en: piercing or hurtful words that touch the core
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চোখা কথা শুনে বন্ধু খুব কষ্ট পেল।
সভায় তার চোখা কথা সকলকে অস্বস্তিতে ফেলে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: His piercing words hurt his friend's feelings deeply.
Her cutting remarks made everyone uncomfortable in the meeting.
note: This idiom reflects the Bengali tendency to use sensory metaphors for emotional impact.
